complexity_ledger.narrative: specs/results/scorecards/portable-substrate/GOAL-dimensions-replicate/RM-04/RESULT.md IN ONE LINE: D3's separation replicated on a second example and D2's movement did not, and the round cannot attribute any of its six tier splits because every opus judge seeded its own faults and no sonnet judge did. WHAT CHANGED, AND WHY EACH IS A REMOVAL OR A REPAIR RATHER THAN AN ADDITION: * `score_tools.py` grew a blinding refusal and a widened label space. Both are refusals -- one REFUSES a scaffold whose blinded card would carry an identifying subject, one REFUSES an explicit label a prior round published unless a reason is recorded. Each ships with a demonstrated failing input on a REAL subject of this repository (`--subject arm_b`, whose scope spells the published label `T`; `--labels T,U`). R1. * `subject.name` and `subject.declared_effect_boundary` are WITHHELD from a blinded card. That is a deletion from what a judge is served. Attack A5's defence is unchanged -- `check` resolves the scope against `subjects.toml` instead of reading a name off the card. * `[[demonstration]]` lost two declared fields and gained no mechanism. * Three tests that pinned "the 49 cards sealed before reading-discipline" as `round != "reading-discipline"` were pinned POSITIVELY. That is not a simplification, it is a correctness fix: the negative form is not a fixed population and had already grown to 55. MEASURED ALTERNATIVES: see `refinement.detail` above and `RESULT.md` section 7, which lists seven things this ticket rejected. THE FINDING THE MACHINE-CHECKED CORE CANNOT EXPRESS: this ticket's own work order is false. It says RM-03's removal is "a genuine before/after" for `scripts/`, and `19c5c7b:scripts` and `dbf355c:scripts` are the same tree, `e9d5544`. Filed as `RM-04-DF-02` and recorded in the sealed predictions before the round rather than discovered afterwards.

refinement.detail: SEARCHED, FOUND NONE, AND THE SEARCH IS THE INTERESTING PART. RM-04 is a measurement round: no TLA+ model is touched, `model_delta_expectation` is `none expected`, and no state-machine representation changed, so there is no refinement of a model to find. The refinement question was asked instead of the two INSTRUMENTS this ticket did change, and both times the answer was to remove rather than to refine. (1) `[[demonstration]].ranges` and `.tiers_measured`: the refinement on offer was a `measured_over` field so `audit` could re-derive them at a declared population. It works. It was REJECTED because the two fields grant no refusal authority at all -- `authority()` reads `separates` alone -- so the refinement would have bought a mechanism for a field that decides nothing. Removed instead. `RM-04-DF-03`. (2) The blind-label pool: the refinement on offer was a larger character pool. REJECTED, because it postpones the same exhaustion by a constant. The mechanism was generalised instead -- a label is a STRING over the unpublished alphabet -- which makes the space unbounded and keeps the property exact rather than counted. NOTHING WAS ADDED THAT MAKES A KNOWN ANSWER SCORE BETTER. The clearest invitation arrived on its own: the subject with the epic's only real before/after had its Python line count RISE across a removal that took 310 lines out of the directory, and a complexity axis counting declarative lines would have fixed that number. That is `MF-020` in its purest form and it was refused. See `RESULT.md` section 7.

ticket.objective: THE ITERATE STEP, ON THE SIMPLIFIED SUBSTRATE. D2 and D3 are the only two dimensions that discriminate and each rests on a narrow base: D2 on TWO PAIRS OF ONE EXAMPLE IN ONE ROUND, flagged by that round's own evaluator as the result to be most suspicious of, AND tier-split opus [4,4] against sonnet [3,3]; D3's architecture tag derived on one example with a state_colocation threshold of 0.5 that HAS NEVER BEEN MEASURED NEAR ITS BOUNDARY. Score THE TOOLCHAIN IN scripts/ as a subject -- it has only ever been the thing DOING the scoring, it is the largest unexamined surface in the project, and RM-03's removal IS a real before/after. Does D2 replicate off ab_quota_ledger? Probe the tag's threshold. And DECIDE D4 AND D5: bind them to evidence a tier cannot swing, or cut the card to two dimensions and three notes. NOT DECIDING IS NOT ACCEPTABLE. THE TRAP: the complexity descriptor could not see the only simplification ever measured -- 19 of 21 axes byte-identical, one moving the WRONG WAY -- and adding an axis tuned to that known answer is MF-020 in its purest form.
